en: If my this vow be not carried out, then the Himalaya mountains might be removed from where they are, the maker of the day (sun) might lose his rays and the Moon his coolness.

sa: सा समीक्ष्य तु तान् देवान् पुण्यश्लोकं च भारत। नैषधं वरयामास भैमीधर्मेण पाण्डव॥
en: O Bharata, she saw both the celestials and that righteous king. But, O descendant of Pandu, the daughter of Bhima accepted (as her husband) the prince of the Nishadhas in accordance with her vow.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मस्थानमनुत्तमम्। तत्राभिगम्य राजेन्द्र ब्रह्माणं पुरुषर्षभ॥ राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां फलं विन्दति मानवः।
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent region of Brahma. O king, going there by that foremost of Purushas, Brahma. A man obtains the fruits of Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices.

sa: सप्तैकैकस्य यूपस्य चषालाचोपरि स्थिताः। तस्य स्म यूपान् यज्ञेषु भ्राजमानान् हिरण्मयान्॥ स्वयमुत्थापयामासुर्देवा: सेन्द्रा युधिष्ठिर। तेषु तस्य मखावयेषु गयस्य पृथिवीपतेः॥ अमाद्यदिन्द्रः सोमेन दक्षिणाभिजिातयः। प्रसंख्यानानसंख्येयान् प्रत्यगृहणन् द्विजातयः॥
en: On each sacrificial stakes seven rings were fastened at the top. O Yudhishthira, the celestials together with Indra erected the sacrificial stakes made of gold which were prepared for his sacred rites. In all these foremost of sacrifices of that great king Gaya, Indra was delighted by drinking the Soma juice and the ministering priests were gratified with the large Dakshinas they received. The Brahmanas obtained untold wealth.

sa: तत्र कूपोदकं कृत्वा तेन स्नातः शुचिस्तथा। पितॄन् देवांस्तु संतर्प्य मुक्तपापो दिवं व्रजेत्॥
en: Drinking there the water of the well and purifying one's self there by a bath and also offering oblations to the Pitris and the celestials, one, being cleansed of his sins, goes to heaven.

sa: धर्मराज उवाच यद्येवमीप्सितं राजन् भुड्क्ष्वास्य सहितः फलम्। तुल्यकालं सहानेन पश्चात् प्राप्स्यसि सद्गतिम्॥
en: Dharmaraja said : O king, if this be your wish, then taste with him the fruits of that act, as long as he is to do. After that you will obtain the blessed state.

sa: नूनं प्रकृतिरेषा ते जघन्या नात्र संशयः। अति पापीयसी चैषा पाण्डवानामपीष्यते॥ येषामर्थ्यतमः कृष्णस्त्वं च येषां प्रदर्शकः। धर्मवांस्त्वमधर्मज्ञः सतां मार्गादवप्लुतः॥
en: There is not the least doubt that your disposition is very mean. It appears the Pandavas also who consider Krishna as deserving of worship and who have you for their leader are of sinful dispositions. Though you possess the knowledge of virtue, yet you have fallen from the path of virtue.

sa: कदलीवनमध्यस्थमथ पीने शिलातले। ददर्श सुमहाबाहुर्वानराधिपति तदा॥
en: The mighty-armed hero saw the monkeychief in the plantain forest, lying on an elevated rocky base. was

sa: दैत्यानां या दितिर्माता तामाहुर्मुखण्डिकाम्। अत्यर्थं शिशुमांसेन सम्प्रहृष्टा दुरासदा॥ कुमाराश्च कुमार्यश्च ये प्रोक्ता: स्कन्दसम्भवाः। तेऽपि गर्भभुजः सर्वे कौरव्य सुमहाग्रहाः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, Diti, the mother of the Daityas, is also called Mukhamandika. That fearful spirit is very fond of little children's flesh. Those male and female children, who are said to have been begotten by Skanda, are also evil spirits; and they all destroy the fetus in the womb.

sa: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि भूतेशं त्र्यक्षं शूलधरं शिवम्। तदा दातास्मि ते तात दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि सर्वशः॥
en: “O child, when you will be able to meet the three-eyes deity, Shiva, the wielder of trident and the lord of all creatures, it is then I shall bestow on you all my weapons.

sa: तस्माद् दुःखादिदं दुःखं गरीय इति मे मतिः॥ यत् तत् परिषदो मध्ये बह्वयुक्तमभाषत।
en: Besides this, other harsh words were spoken by him. But this is my opinion, that the grief I now feel in parting with you is greater than any I felt then at his words.

sa: एतच्चापि तपो राजन् पुराणमिति नः श्रुतम्। विधिना पालनं भूमेर्यत् कृतं न पितामहैः॥
en: O king, it has been heard by us in the Puranas that to protect one's own kingdom and cherish one's own subjects, as was done by our forefathers, is a kind of Tapa (austerities).

sa: अमानुषगति प्राप्ताः संसिद्धाः स्म वृकोदर। लताभिः पुष्पिताग्राभिः पुष्पिताः पादपोत्तमाः॥ संश्लिष्टाः पार्थ शोभन्ते गन्धमादनसानुषु। शिखण्डिनीभिश्चरतां सहितानां शिखण्डिनाम्॥ नदतां शृणु निर्घोषं भीम पर्वतसानुषु। चकोराः शतपत्राश्च मत्तकोकिलसारिकाः॥
en: O Vrikodara, by our arrival here we have attained to a state transcending the human and our desire has been fulfilled. O Partha, on these plateaus of the Gandhamadana, you excellent blossoming trees, embraced by flower creepers, look supremely handsome. O Bhima, listen to the warbles of the peacocks wandering with their sweet-hearts on the slopes of the mountain, of the Chataka, Satapatra and maddened Kokila and Sarikas.

sa: भर्तुश्चापि हितं यत् तत् सततं सानुवर्तते। देवतातिथिभृत्यानां श्वश्रूश्वशुरयोस्तथा॥ शुश्रूषणपरा नित्यं सततं संयतेन्द्रिया।
en: She was always attentive to what was beneficial to her husband and with her controlled passions she daily attended to the service of the gods, the guests, the mother-inlaw, the father-in-law and the servants.

sa: असज्जनेनाचरितानि पुत्र पापान्यपेयानि मधूनि तानि। माल्यानि चैतानि न वै मुनीनां स्मृतानि चित्रोज्जवलगन्धवन्ति॥
en: O son, those are intoxicating liquors, they are drunk by unrighteous men and they are unworthy to be drunk (by good men). These fragrant, bright and many coloured garlands are not for the ascetics.

sa: मधुकैटभावूचतुः अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं नौ स्वैरेष्वपि कुतोऽन्यथा। सत्ये धर्मे च निरतौ विद्ध्यावां पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: Madhu Kaitabha said: foremost of Purushas, we have never before spoken an untruth, not even in joke, what to speak of the other occasions? Know that we are always firm in truth and morality.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अन्येनान्यस्य वै द्यूतं विषमं प्रतिभाति मे। एतद् विद्वन्नुपादत्स्व काममेवं प्रवर्तताम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Gambling by one on another's behalf seems to me to be contrary to rule. O learned man, you too will admit this. If however, you still desire it, let the play begin.

sa: यो दरिद्रैरपि विधिः शक्यः प्राप्तुं नरेश्वर। तुल्यो यज्ञफलैः पुण्यैस्तुं निबोध युधां वर॥
en: O ruler of men, best of warriors, I shall now tell you about that which can be performed by the poor and the fruits of which are equal to those sacred ones of sacrifices.

sa: अथ तां राक्षसी मायामुत्थितां घोरदर्शनाम्। रक्षोनैर्विविधैर्मन्त्रैर्बोम्यः सम्यक्प्रयोजितैः॥ पश्यतां पाण्डुपुत्राणां नाशयामास वीर्यवान्। स नष्टमायोऽतिबलः क्रोधविस्फारितेक्षणः॥ काममूर्तिधरः क्रूरः कालकल्पो व्यदृश्यत। तमुवाच ततो राजा दीर्घप्रज्ञो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: (Thereupon) the greatly powerful Dhaumya destroyed in the presence of the sons of Pandu, the fearful Rakshasas illusion by applying various Mantras calculated to destroy the Rakshasass. Seeing his illusion destroyed, that Rakshasas of crooked ways, who was capable of assuming any form at will, expanded his eyes in anger and he appeared like Death himself. Then the greatly intelligent Yudhishthira thus spoke to him.

sa: कुमारमभिगम्याथ वीराश्रमनिवासिनम्॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति नरो नास्त्यत्र संशयः।
en: Seeing Kumara (Kartikeya) who lives in Virasrama, a man obtains without doubt the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sa: लोमश उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वाब्रवीद् रामः प्रदीप्त इव मन्युना। श्रूयते क्षम्यते चैव दर्पपूर्णोऽसि भार्गव॥
en: Having heard this, Rama, blazing up in wrath, thus spoke to him, “O descendant of Bhrigu, I have heard what you have said and I have also pardoned you. You are full of vanity.

sa: दृढमूला वयं राज्ये मित्राणि परिगृह्य च। सारवद् विपुलं सैन्यं सत्कृत्य च दुरासदम्॥
en: We shall in the meantime be firmly rooted in the kingdom and making alliances (with other kings), we shall be able to get together a vast and invincible army and to keep them content.

sa: तथा ते न कृतं राजन् पुत्रस्नेहान्नराधिप। तस्य प्राप्तं फलं विद्धि कुलान्तकरणाय यत्॥
en: O king, O ruler of men, you could not do it before from the affection you bear for your son. Know that the time has come for the destruction of our race through him.

sa: देवपुत्रौ महाभागौ देवराजसमद्युती। नकुलः सहदेवश्च पाण्डवौ युद्धदुर्मदौ॥ दृढायुधौ दूरपातौ युद्धे च कृतनिश्चयौ। शीघ्रहस्तौ दृढक्रोधौ नित्ययुक्तौ तरस्विनौ॥ भीमार्जुनौ पुरोधाय यदा तौ रणमूर्धनि। स्थास्येते सिंहविक्रान्तावश्विनाविव दुःसहौ॥ न शेषमिह पश्यामि मम सैन्यस्य संजय। तौ ह्यप्रतिरथौ युद्धे देवपुत्रौ महारथौ॥
en: When the two Pandavas, Nakula and Sahadeva who are of divine origin, most exalted, equal to the king of the gods in splendour, invincible in battle, steady in management of weapons, able to shoot at a great distance indefatigable in battle, lighthanded, of inextinguishable wrath, persevering, of untiring activity, mighty as the lions, unbearable as the Ashvins themselves will come to the field of battle placing Bhima and Arjuna in the front, then I see, O Sanjaya, that my soldiers will be slain to a mass; and those mighty and matchless warriors of divine origin will not show mercy.

sa: जरत्कारुर्जरत्कार्वां पुलस्त्यश्च प्रतीच्यया। मेनकायां यथोर्णायुस्तुम्बुस्श्चैव रम्भया॥
en: As Jaratkaru with Jaratkaru, as Pulastya with Pratichya, as Urnayas with Menaka and as Tambura with Rambha;

sa: विदुरः सर्वकल्याणैरभिगम्य जनार्दनम्। अर्चयामास दाशार्ह सर्वकामैरुपस्थितम्॥
en: Vidura approached and worshipped Janardana of the Dasharha race and presented him every auspicious and desirable offering.

sa: आक्रुश्यमानो न वदामि किंचित् क्षमाम्यहं ताड्यमानश्च नित्यम्। श्रेष्ठं ह्येतद् यत्क्षमामाहुरार्याः सत्यं तथैवार्जवमानृशंस्यम्॥
en: As for myself, I never answer when another speaks ill of me. If attacked, I always forgive the assault. The righteous hold that forgiveness, truth, sincerity and compassion are the foremost (of all virtues).

sa: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गः कालसृष्ट इवान्तकः॥ विस्फुरदिश्च तैद्रौणिर्निस्त्रिंशस्योद्यमेन च।
en: Making his foes to tremble by the repeated blows of his sword, Ashvatthaman was covered with blood.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच अनायसं मुने शस्त्रं मृदु विद्यामहं कथम्। येनैषामुद्धरे जिह्वां परिमृज्यानुमृज्य च।॥
en: Vasudeva said What is that weapon, O sage, which is not made of steel, which is mild, which still cuts all hearts, and which I must use for correcting the tongues of my kinsmen?

sa: इन्द्रो यमो वैश्रवणो वरुणश्च जलेश्वरः। नैतेऽपि तुल्या मरुतः किं पुनस्त्वं वनस्पते॥
en: Even Indra, Yama, Vaishravana, of Varuna the king of the waters, is not equal to the god of wind in might. What to speak of you who are only a tree.

sa: मेधावी स्मृतिमान् दक्षः प्रकृत्या चानृशंस्यवान्। यो मानितोऽमानितो वा न च दुष्येत् कदाचन॥ ऋत्विग्वा यदि वाऽऽचार्यः सखा वात्यन्तसंस्तुतः। गृहे वसेदमात्यस्ते स स्यात् परमपूजितः॥
en: That person who is endued with intelligence and memory, who is smart in transacting business, who is by nature shorn of cruelty, who is never wrathful, and who whether honoured or neglected is never dissatisfied, be he your priest or preceptor or trusted friend, should always receive your adoration if he accepts the office of your counsellor and lives in your palace.

sa: सुखं दुःखान्तमालस्यं दुःखं दाक्ष्यं सुखोदयम्। भूतिस्त्वेवं श्रिया सार्धं दक्षे वसति नालसे॥
en: Happiness must terminate in misery. Idleness is misery; while cleverness (in action) is the root of felicity. Affluence and prosperity live in a clever man, but not in an idle wight.

sa: प्रविश्य च गृहं रम्यमासनेनाभिपूजितः। अर्येण च स वै तेन व्याधेन द्विजसत्तमः॥
en: Having entered his beautiful abode, he honoured him with a seat. Accepting the water that was given to him for washing the feet and face, the foremost of the regenerate ones.

sa: एवं प्रवृत्ते संग्रामे गजवादिनरक्षये॥ सैन्येन रजसा व्याप्ते स्वे स्वाञ्जघ्नुः परे परान्।
en: When the battle, destructive of elephants, horses and men, thus raged on the field was enshrouded with dust raised by the troops; the enemies then killed enemies and friends killed friends.

sa: सामरानपि लोकांस्त्रीन् सर्वान् स्थावरजङ्गमान्। भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च निमेषादिति मे मतिः॥
en: The three words with all their celestial and all things movable, and all beings that were, or are to b, in the twinkling of an eye; such is what I think.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र पुरस्कृत्य गान्धारी च पतिव्रताम्। सह तैर्ऋषिभिः सर्वैतृभिः केशवेन च॥ पौरजानपदैश्चैव मन्त्रिवृद्धैश्च पार्थिव। प्रविवेश कुरुश्रेष्ठः पुरं वारणसाह्वयम्॥
en: Headed by Dhritarashtra and also Gandhari who was greatly devoted to her husband and accompanied by the Rishis and Keshava as also by the citizens and the inhabitants of the country and by his counsellors, O monarch, that foremost one of Kuru's race entered the city of Hastinapur.

sa: वैशंपायन उवाच आमन्त्र्य तौ धर्मराजमनुज्ञाष्य च भारत। जग्मतुः पार्थगोविन्दौ सुहृज्जनवृतौ ततः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O descendant of Bharata, having consulted with each other and after receiving Yudhishthira's permission, Partha (Arjuna) and Govinda (Krishna) in company with their friends set out (for the Yamuna).

sa: धनुश्चास्य महच्चित्रं क्षुरेण प्रचकर्त ह। हस्तावापं पताकां च ध्वजं चास्य न्यपातयत्॥
en: With a razor-headed arruw he then cut off Meghasandhi's large and beautiful bow, and then his leathern fence. Then cutting off his flag and flag-staff, he caused it to fall down.

sa: अभिगम्य च तत् तुष्ट्या दत्तमाहुरभिष्टुतम्। याचितेन तु तद् दत्तं तदाहुर्मध्यमं बुधाः॥
en: The gift is highly valued which the donor inakes after seeking out the done and respecting him properly. That gift is middling which the donor makes upon being prayed for it.

sa: स तं पप्रच्छ कौन्तेयः पुनः पुनररिंदमम्। धर्मजः शक्रजं जिष्णुं समाचष्ट जगत्पतिः॥
en: The son of Kunti repeatedly asked Krishna, that chastiser of enemies, about Arjuna. To Dharma's son, the lord of all the universe began to speak about Jishnu, the son of Shakra.

sa: मुह्यन्तीव हि मे सर्वा धनंजयदिदृक्षया। दिशश्च प्रदिशः पार्थ सात्वतस्य च कारणात्॥
en: O son of Pritha, the cardinal and subsidiary uarter appear to me to be void in consequence f my unsatisfied desire to see Dhananjaya and lat hero of the Satvata race."

sa: भीष्म उवाच वासुदेवो महद् भूतं सर्वदैवतदैवतम्। न परं पुण्डरीकाक्षाद् दृश्यते भरतर्षभ॥
en: Bhishma said Vasudeva is the Supreme Being, the God of all gods. There is to be seen none, O foremost of the Bharata, superior to Him of eyes resembling lotus petals.

sa: तद् वर्म हेमविकृतं रत्नचित्रं बभौ पतत्। सविद्युदभ्रं सवितुः श्लिष्टं वातहतं यथा॥
en: Made of gold and set with jewels that armour looked beautiful as if it fell down like the cloud driven by the wind and smitten by the rays of the sun.

sa: यत्र पापा ज्ञायमानाश्चरन्ति सतां कलिविन्दते तत्र राज्ञः। स्तदा राज्यं वर्धते भूमिपस्य॥
en: When sinful men of known acts are allowed to move among the righteous, Kali then overtakes the kings of those kingdoms. When the king punishes all wicked people, his kingdom prospers.

sa: अधरोत्तरमेतद् वा लोकानां वा पराभवः। यदिमौ जीवतः कृष्णौ कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः॥
en: Or is it something beyond the natural order of things or is it the defeat of the three worlds, inasmuch as the two Krishnas are still alive. Time indeed, is irresistible.

sa: यदा युक्त्या नयेदर्थान् कामादर्थवशेन वा। कृपणं याचमानानां तद् राज्ञो वैशसं महत्॥
en: When the officers of the king extort money, hy unfair mean, or acting from lust or avarice, from persons pitcously praying for mercy, a great destruct' on, jorsooth, be.ails the king.

sa: अव्याहृतं व्याहृताच्छ्रेय आहुः सत्यं वदेद् व्याहृतं तद् द्वितीयम्। वदेद् व्याहृतं तत् तृतीयं प्रियं धर्मं वदेद् व्याहृतं तच्चतुर्थम्॥
en: Silence is better than speech. To speak the truth is better than silence. To speak, again, truth what is connected with virtue is better than to speak the truth. To speak what, besides being true and righteous is agrecable, is better than to speak truth connected with virtue.

sa: स एव बलवान् भूत्वा पुनर्भवति दुर्बलः॥ स एवेशश्च भूत्वेह परैराज्ञाप्यते पुनः।
en: One becomes powerful, and, again, losing that power, becomes weak. One becomes a master and rules others, and again, losing that position, becomes a servant for obeying the order of others.

sa: विना जनार्दनं वीरं नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥ श्रुत्वैव हि गतं विष्णुं ममापि मुमुहुर्दिशः।
en: I dare not live, reft of the heroic Janardana. As soon as I heard that Vishnu had left the earth, my eyes became dim and all things disappeared from my vision.

sa: न ह्यल्पवीर्यो भवति यो वाहान् कुरुते मुनीन्। अहं तपस्वी बलवान् भूतभव्यभवत्प्रभुः॥
en: The one who makes the Rishis his bearers cannot be of little strength. I am a devotee, strong and lord of what has been, what is to be and what is.

sa: कर्ण उवाच राधेयोऽहमाधिरथिः कर्णस्त्वामभिवादये। प्राप्ता किमर्थं भवती ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते॥
en: Karna said I am Karna, the son of Radha and the son of Adhiratha and I salute you. Why are you come here? Tell me what I shall do for you.

sa: नावमन्यामि ते बुद्धिं नावमन्ये च पौरुषम्। नावमन्ये जयामिति जितवद् वर्ततां भवान्।॥
en: I honour you intelligence, and I honour your power. I do not disregard you, saying that I have conquered you. On the other hand, live you with me as a victor.

sa: किं न पश्यमि मां पाप गदायुद्धे व्यवस्थितम्। हिमवच्छिखराकारां प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्॥
en: Why do you not see me, O wretch, standing here for an encounter with the mace? Am I not armed with a formidable mace that looks like a summit of Himavat?

sa: सा तेऽहं दुःखमाख्यास्ये प्रणयान्मधुसूदन। ईशस्त्वं सर्वभूतानां ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः॥
en: O slayer of Madhu, impelled by the affection, you bore for me, I shall relate to you my grief's. You are the supreme lord of all creatures, both celestials and human.

sa: स मां प्रज्वलितं दृष्ट्वा मेघाम्भोभिः प्रवर्षति। ततो दग्धुं न शक्नोमि दिधक्षुर्दावमीप्सिताम्॥
en: Whenever he sees me blazing up in this forest), he pours upon me waters from the clouds. I cannot thus succeed to consume it, though very much desirous of doing it.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सम्यक् त्वयायं नृपते वर्णित; शिष्टसम्मतः। योगमार्गो यथान्यायं शिष्यायेह हितैषिणा॥
en: Yudhishthira said O king, you have duly described to me, in the proper way, the path of Yoga which is approved by the wise, like a loving preceptor to his pupil.

sa: साहसानां च सर्वेषामकार्याणां क्रियास्तथा। जातौ बाल्ये च कौमारे यौवने चापि मानवाः॥
en: Men are unable, whether infants or youths or men, to cast off covetousness in life. Such is the nature of covetousness that it never disappears even with the loss of life.

sa: इदं विश्वं जगत् सर्वमजगच्चापि यद् भवेत्। महाभूतात्मकं सर्वं महद् यत् परमाश्रयात्॥
en: This entire universe of matier, and that which is called Mahat or Buddhi, are formed of great elements. That which is called Mahat is due to the action of the Supreme.

sa: अभिषेकांश्च नियमान् देवतायतनेषु च। बलिं च कृत्वा हत्वा च देवतां चाप्यपूजयत्॥
en: He began to perform ablutions thrice a day, observe other vows, make sacrifices to the gods, pour libations on the sacrificial fire, and adore and worship the gods in this way.

sa: द्विजातेः कस्यचित् पार्थ स्वाध्यायनिरतस्य वै। पुत्रो बभूव मेधावी मेधावी नाम नामतः॥
en: Once on a time, O son of Pritha, a twiceborn person devoted to only the study of the Vedas had a very intelligent son who passed by the name of Medhavin.

sa: दृष्ट्वैव तं महाबाहुं तस्य भक्तिरजायत। अयं मे धास्यति श्रेयो वपुरेतद्धि तादृशम्॥
en: As soon as he saw that mighty-armed being, the Brahmana's feelings of devotion were excited, and he said to himself,-This one will surely give me prosperity! Indeed, his form indicates it.

sa: एवमादीनि चान्यानि परित्यक्तानि मेधया। ज्वलन्ति यशसा लोके यानि न व्याहरन्ति च॥
en: Similarly those men shine in the world with celebrity who by the help of their intelligence, renounce these and similar other faults and who do not blaze forth their own virtues.

sa: बह्वलीकमसत्यं चाप्यतिवादाप्रियंवदम्। इमं प्रेक्ष्य पुनर्भावं दुःखशोकविवर्धनम्॥ न मे मानुषलोकोऽयं मुहूर्तमपि रोचते।
en: It is full of vanities and falsehoods, accusations and evil reports! Witnessing again this incident which increases pain and grief, I do not for a moment like this world of men.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच उपदेशेन युष्माकमाहारोऽयं कृतो मया। द्विरूनं दशरात्रं वै नागस्यागमनं प्रति॥
en: The Brahmana said On account of these solicitations of you all, I may be considered to have broken my fast. Eight days remain when the king of the Nagas will return.

sa: कस्यान्यस्य सुरैः सर्वैर्लिङ्गं मुक्त्वा महेश्वरम्। अर्च्यतेऽर्चितपूर्व वा ब्रूहि यद्यस्ति ते श्रुतिः॥
en: If Mahesvara be not accepted, tell me, if you have ever heard of it, who else is there whose einblem has been adored or is being adored by all the celestials?

sa: मा च तेऽभूत् स्वभावोऽयमिति ते देवपुङ्गवा ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां विक्रमेण जितो बलात्॥
en: O king of gods, let not your nature be so. Do not think that you have become the king of all creatures after having defeated all with your might and prowess.

sa: क्षिप्यन्ते तेन तेनैव निष्टनन्तः पुनः पुनः। कालेन जाता याता हि वायुनेवाभ्रसंचयाः॥
en: Creatures, as they are carried along the current to time, become again and again are drawn towards one another like clouds moved by the wind meeting one another with loud noise.

sa: सा तस्य दृष्वैव मनो जहार शुभलोचना। वनराजी यथा चित्रा वसन्ते कुसुमाचिता॥
en: By a look only that girl of beautiful eyes had robbed him of his heart even as a delightful grove in spring, decked with flowers robs the spectator of his heart.

sa: मनः षष्ठानि सर्वाणि बुद्ध्यभावे कुतो गणाः॥ येन पश्यति तच्चक्षुः शृण्वती श्रोत्रमुच्यते। जिघ्रती भवति घ्राणं रसती रसना रसान्॥
en: When the Understanding is not, the senses with the mind, and the five other attributes, cease to be. That by which the understanding sees is called the eye. When she smells, the becomes the organ of smell; and when she tastes the various objects, she is called tongue.

sa: यो दुर्लभतरं प्राप्य मानुष्यं द्विषते नरः। धर्मावमन्ता कामात्मा भवेत्स खलु वञ्च्यते॥
en: That man who, having been born as a man that is so difficult of attainment, indulges in malice, disregards righteousness and gives way :o desire, is certainly betrayed by his desires.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किंशील: किंसमाचार: किंविद्यः किंपराक्रमः। प्राप्नोति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं यत्परं प्रकृतेर्बुवम्॥
en: Yudhisthira said By what nature, what course of duties, what knowledge, and what energy, does one succeed in attaining to Brahma which is immutable and is beyond the reach of nature.

sa: एकीभूतस्य न त्वस्य धारणे तेजसः प्रभो। समर्था सकला पृथ्वी बहुधा सृज्यतामयम्॥
en: O powerful one, if the energy of this Being remains intact, then the entire Earth herself will not be able to bear him. Let him, therefore, be divided into many parts.

sa: सर्वतश्च प्रशान्ता ये सर्वभूतहिते रताः। न क्रुद्ध्यन्ति न हृष्यन्ति नापराध्यन्ति कर्हिचित्॥
en: They are tranquil regarding all their desires, and are engaged in the well being of the creatures. They never give way to anger to indulge in joy, or injure any creature.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं वैशम्पायन कीर्तितम्॥ जनमेजयेन तच्छ्रुत्वा कृतं सम्यग् यथाविधि।
en: Suta said I have now told you all that Vaishampayana recounted to Janamejaya. Having listened to Vaishampayana's narration, king Janamejaya severe duly satisfied all his duties according to the scriptural ordinances.

sa: पृथिवीं रत्नपूर्णां वा महद् वा रत्नसंचयम। भक्ताय नाहमिच्छामि भवेदेष तु धार्मिकः॥
en: I do not pray for this devotee of mine mountains of pearls and gems, or even the whole Earth with all her riches. I wish, however, that he should be virtuous.

sa: नियमो ह्येषु वर्णेषु यतीनां शून्यवासिता। शून्यमावेशयन्त्या च मया किं कस्य दूषितम्॥
en: The practice with Yatis is to live in uninhabited or deserted adodes. What harm them have I done to whom by entering your understanding which is indeed shorn of true knowledge?

sa: अद्रोहेणैव भूतानामल्पद्रोहेण वा पुनः। या वृत्तिः स परो धर्मस्तेन जीवामि जाजले॥
en: The highest form of morality consists in a living which is founded upon total harmlessness towards all creatures or upon the smallness of such harin. I live according to that mode,OJajali.

sa: सम्भाव्य चटकान् मूनि जाजलिर्जपतां वरः। आस्फोटयत् तथाऽऽकाशे धर्मः प्राप्तो मयेति वै॥
en: Having thus made those chataka birds, grow on his head, Jajali that foremost of ascetics, began to strike his armpits and cry loudly through the sky, I have acquired great merit.

sa: वेदे वचनमुक्तं तु कुरु कर्म त्यजेति च। कथमेतद् विजानीयां तच्च व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: In the Vedas there are both kinds of saying, do acts and avoid acts. How shall I succeed in determining which of the two is right? You should explain this clearly.

sa: अग्नेर्भूमेरपां वायोरन्तरिक्षस्य वा विभो। धैर्येण सम्मितः पुत्रो मम भूयादिति स्म ह॥
en: The prayer he offered to the great God was,-~O powerful one, let me have a son that will have the might of Fire and Earth and Weather and Wind and Ether.

sa: रिपौ मित्रेऽथ मध्यस्थे विजये संधिविग्रहे। कृतवान् यो महीपालः किं तस्मिन् मुक्तलक्षणम्।।१३०
en: What marks of Liberation can be said to take place in that king who acts as others act towards enemies and allies and neutrals and in victory and trace and war?

sa: विज्ञानार्थं हि पञ्चानामिच्छा पूर्वं प्रवर्तते। प्राप्यैकं जायते कामो द्वेषो वा भरतर्षभ॥
en: Perceiving any one of the five objects, desire runs after it at first. Indeed, obtaining them within the pale of the senses, O foremost of Bharata's family, desire or hatred originates.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु भगवान् गुणांस्तस्य महात्मनः। उपस्पृश्य शुचिर्भूत्वा कथयामास धीमतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said these words, the illustrious Vasudeva began his discourse on the qualities of the great Mahadeva gifted with the highest intelligence, after having purified himself by touching water.

sa: आहत्य सर्वसंकल्पान् सत्त्वे चित्तं निवेशयेत्। सत्त्वे चित्तं समावेश्य ततः कालंजरो भवेत्॥
en: Destroying all desires, one should drown the gross understanding into one's subtile Understanding. Having thus drowned the gross into the subtile Understanding, one is sure to become a second Kalanjara mountain.

sa: एष ते कथितो धर्मः सात्वतः कुरुनन्दन। कुरुरुष्वैनं यथान्यायं यदि शक्तोऽसि भारत्॥
en: I have thus explained to you, O son of Kuru's race, what the religion of Goodness is. If you be qualified for it, O Bharata, do you practise that religion duly.

sa: जायमानं हि पुरुष यं पश्येन्मधुसूदनः। सात्त्विकस्तु स विज्ञेयो भवेन्मोक्षे च निश्चितः॥
en: That man subject to birth (and death) upon whom Hari casts a kind eye should be known as gifted with the quality of Goodness and devoted to the acquisition of Liberation.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि पुराणमृषिसंस्तुतम्। इन्द्रोत: शौनको विप्रो यदाह जनमेजयम्॥
en: Bhishma said In this connection I shall recite to you the old narrative, spoken highly of by the Rishis, of what the twice-born Indrota, the son of Shunaka, said to Janamejaya.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच यत् किंचिदिह लोके वै देहसत्त्वं विशाम्पते॥ सर्वं पञ्चभिराविष्टं भूतैरीश्वरबुद्धिभिः।
en: Vaishampayana said All existent objects, O king, in this world, are the outcome of a combination of the five principal elements, a cornbination due to the intelligence of the Supreme Lord.

sa: सर्वोपायात् तु कामस्य क्रोधस्य च विनिग्रहः। कार्यः श्रेयोऽर्थिना तौ हि श्रेयोघातार्थमुद्यतौ॥
en: One should, by every means in his power, control both desire and anger if one tries to acquire what is for his good. Those two originate for only destroying his good.

sa: वायुरुवाच शाल्मले नारदो गच्छंस्त्वयोक्तो मद्विगर्हणम्। अहं वायुः प्रभावं ते दर्शयाम्यात्मनो बलम्॥
en: The Wind-god said O Shalmali, you have uttered derogatory words against me before Narada, know that I am the God of wind. I shall certainly show you my power and might.

sa: सूच्या सूत्रं यथा वस्त्रे संसारयति वायकः। तद्वत् संसारसूत्रं हि तृष्णासूच्या निबद्ध्यते॥
en: As a weaver drives his threads into a cloth by means of his shuttle, similarly the threads that constitute the fabric of the universe are woven by the shuttle of Desire.

sa: अश्रद्धा परमं पापं श्रद्धा पापप्रमोचिनी। जहाति पापं श्रद्धावान् सर्पो जीर्णामिव त्वचम्॥
en: Want of Faith is a great sin. Faith is a purifier of sins. Like a snake casting off its slough, the man of Faith succeeds in shaking off all his sins.

sa: ज्ञात्वाऽऽत्मस्थं हरि चैव न निवर्तन्ति तेऽव्ययाः। प्राप्य तत् परमं स्थानं मोदन्तेऽक्षरमव्ययम्॥
en: Realising that Brahma lives in their souls, they become themselves immutable and have never to come back to the Earth). Acquiring that supreme, indestructible and eternal state they live in happiness.

sa: गृहारम्भो हि दुःखाय न सुखाय कदाचन। सर्पः परकृतं वेश्म प्रविश्य सुखमेधते॥
en: To build a house for one's ownself conduces not to his happiness but becomes the source of his annoyance. The snake residing in another creature's place of abode, lives in happiness.

sa: ततः प्रदुद्रुवुः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा रक्षःपराक्रमम्। ततो नदीर्गुहाश्चैव विविशुर्भयपीडिताः। त्यक्तप्रहरणाः श्रान्ता विवर्णवदनास्तदा॥
en: And witnessing the prowess of the Rākșasa, all began to flee; and then they afflicted with affright, fatigued, and with pale faces entered into rivers and caves, leaving their arms behind.

sa: न खल्वियं मतिश्रेष्ठ यत्त्वां सम्प्रेषयाम्यहम्। इयं च राजधर्माणां क्षत्रस्य च मतिर्मता॥
en: O foremost of intelligent ones, (that I send you to battle) is certainly not proper; yet this course of action is endorsed by Kșatriyas and those following the morality of kings.

sa: अप्रमत्तं कथं तं तु विजिगीषु बले स्थितम्। जितरोषं दुराधर्षं तं धर्षयितुमिच्छथ॥
en: But why do you intend to discomfit (Rāma), who is vigilant, who desire victory, who is strong in the Divine strength, who has subdued passion, and who is hard to subdue?

sa: पुत्रप्रवादेन तु रावणस्य त्वमिन्द्रजिन्मित्रमुखोऽसि शत्रुः। यस्येदृशं राघवतो विनाशं निशम्य मोहादनुमन्यसे त्वम्॥
en: You are known as a son to Ravana, O Indrajit, but in sooth, you are his foe in disguise, since knowing of his destruction from Rāghava, you did not prevent him.

sa: एवं भविष्यथेत्युक्त्वा सुकेशतनयान्विभुः। स ययौ ब्रह्मलोकाय ब्रह्मा ब्राह्मणवत्सलः॥ वरं लब्ध्वा तु ते सर्वे राम रात्रिंचरास्तदा। सुरासुरान्प्रबाधन्ते वरदानसुनिर्भयाः॥
en: Thereat saying 'So be it,' to the sons of Sukeśa, the lord Brahmā, (ever) cherishing Brāhmaṇas with affection, went to the Brahmā regions. O Rāma, having obtained the boons, those night-rangers, rendered intrepid in consequences of having the boon conferred on them, began to disturb celestials and Asuras.

sa: पन्नगैः सह दीप्तास्यैः समुद्रः प्रत्यदृश्यत। स्निग्धवैदूर्यसंकाशो जाम्बूनदविभूषणः॥ रत्नमाल्याम्बरधरः पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः। सर्वपुष्पमयीं दिव्यां शिरसा धारयन्स्रजम्॥ जातरूपमयैश्चैव तपनीयविभूषणैः। आत्मजानां च रत्नानां भूषितो भूषणोत्तमैः॥ धातुभिर्मण्डितः शैलो विविधैर्हिमवानिव। एकावलीमध्यगतं तरलं पाण्डरप्रभम्॥ विपुलेनोरसा बिभ्रत्कौस्तुभस्य सहोदरम्। आपूर्णिततरङ्गौघः कालिकानिलसंकुलः।। गङ्गासिन्धुप्रधानाभिरापगाभिः समावृतः।
en: And accompanied by Pannagas* of flaming faces, the Ocean showed himself, appearing like cool lapises, adorned with golden ornaments, wearing a wreath of gems and a jewelled vesture, with his eyes resembling lotus-leaves, bearing on his head a noble garland containing all flowers; decked with ornaments of polished gold; as well with excellent ornaments of gems originating in himself, like the mountains Himavān embellished with metals (sprung in himself).-(the Ocean arose) with wave on wave whirling around, and rife with winds blowing among clouds, surrounded by streams, Gangā, Sindhu (and others). *Semi-divine serpents.

sa: सायुधा बहवो व्योम्नि राक्षसास्त्वं निरायुधः। कथं शक्ष्यसि संयातुं मां चैव परिरक्षितुम्॥
en: And on the sky the Rākşasas shall be armed with weapons and you shall be without any. How shall you be able to fight and protect me at the same time.

sa: बालिशो वत कामात्मा रामो दशरथात्मजः। इति वक्ष्यति मां लोको जानकीमविशोध्य हि॥
en: If I would take the daughter of Janaka without purifying her, people would say that Rāma the son of king Dasaratha is lustful and ignorant of the morality of the people.

sa: अथेन्द्रकल्पस्य दुरासदस्य महौजसस्तद्वचनं निशम्य। ततो महार्थं वचनं बभाषे विभीषणः शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठः।।।।।
en: Hearing the words of (Indrajit) gifted with high energy irrepressible and resembling the lord of celestials, Vibhisana, the foremost of those using weapons, addressed him with words, fraught with high import.

sa: स तदा तद् गृहं दृष्ट्वा महाहाटकतोरणम्॥ राक्षसेन्द्रस्य विख्यातमद्रिमूर्ध्नि प्रतिष्ठितम्। पुण्डरीकावतंसाभिः परिखाभिः समावृतम्॥ प्राकारावृतमत्यन्तं ददर्श स महाकपिः। त्रिविष्टपनिभं दिव्यं दिव्यनादविनादितम्॥ वाजिह्वेषितसंघुष्टं नादितं भूषणैस्तथा। रथैर्यानैर्विमानैश्च तथा हयगजैः शुभैः॥ वारणैश्च चतुर्दन्तैः श्वेताभ्रनिचयोपमैः। भूषितै रुचिरद्वारं मत्तैश्च मृगपक्षिभिः॥
en: Having seen that edifice situated in front of the inner apartment, that mighty monkey saw the famous mansion of the Rākşasa chief, pinnacled or the mountain-top, with huge golden arches over the gateway; surrounded by a moat enriched with pale lotuses; and completely guarded by a wall; resembling heaven, itself; magnificent; resonant with grateful sounds; resounding with the neighing of horses and wondrous steeds; and adorned with cars and vehicles, chariots and dainty horse: elephants, and four-tusked elephants* resembling masses of white clouds; and possessing graceful gateways. Elephants of the size of horses.

sa: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे। रामे दुःखाभिपन्ने तु लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते॥
en: O exalted one, I swear by truth, Rāma turn away he countenance (from every work) in consequence of grief for you. And Rāma being seized with sorrow, Laksmana burns in grief.

sa: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रः स रावणः॥ दौरात्म्येनात्मनोद्भूतस्तप्ताम्भा इव सागरः। ततोऽब्रवीद्दशग्रीवः क्रुद्धः संरक्तलोचनः॥
en: Hearing the words of Vibhīşaņa, Råvana, the lord of Rākşasas, became agitated like an ocean, by the recollection of his vicious deeds. And engaged, with blood-red eyes the ten-necked demon said.

sa: नैतत्किंचन रामस्य न च रामो मुमूर्षति। नोन हास्यते लक्ष्मीर्दुर्लभा या गतायुषाम्॥
en: This is nothing to Rāma is not dying. And Lakşmi* who is incapable of being attained by those that are doomed, shall not forsake this one. *The goddess of prosperity. to

sa: ततः स शैलाभिनिपातभग्नो महोदरस्तेन महाद्विपेन। व्यामोहितो भूमितले गतासुः पपात वज्राभिहतो यथाद्रिः॥
en: Struck by that mighty enemy, Mahodara, broken down by the impetus of that rock, deprived of his senses, dropped down dead on the ground, like a cliff smite with the thunderbolt.

sa: ततः प्रभृति यक्षोऽसौ पार्श्वमौलिरभूत्किल। तस्मिंस्तु विमुखीभूते माणिभद्रे महात्मनि। संनादः सुमहानराजेस्तस्मिन्शैले व्यवर्धत॥
en: From that day forth that Yaksa remained with his head hollow on one side. And on the highsouled Māņibhadra having been baffled, a great uproar, O king rose in that mountain.

sa: मार्गमाणस्तु वैदेहीं राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः। गोदावरीमनुचरन्वनोद्देशांश्च पुष्पितान्॥ आसेदतुर्महारण्ये कबन्धं नाम राक्षसम्। ततः कबन्धवचनाद्रामः सत्यपराक्रमः॥ ऋष्यमूकगिरं गत्वा सुग्रीवेण समागतः।
en: And searching Vaidehi and ranging at the banks of Godaveri and forest-lands covered with flowers, Rāma with Laksmana, met in that huge forest a Rākşasa named Kabandha. Thereupon at the words of Kabandha, Rāma, having truth for his prowess, repairing to the mount Rishyamuka, was united with Sugrīva.

sa: ततस्तथेति प्रतिगृह्य तद्वचस्तदैव दूताः सहसा महद्बलम्। समानयंश्चैव समागतं च न्यवेदयन्भर्तरि युद्धकाङ्क्षिणि।
en: Then assenting to his speech with So be it, the envoys immediately summoned that mighty force; and, when in had arrived, they informed their master, eager for conflict, of its arrival.

sa: प्रपन्नो दीर्घमध्वानं राजन्नद्य सुदुर्गमम्॥ नय मामपि दुःखाता न वर्तिष्ये त्वया विना।
en: You have, O king. reached the way long and hard to be treaded-do you take me. who am stricken with grief and who shall not be able to live without you.

sa: साधुर्वा यदि वासाधुः परैरेष समर्पितः। ब्रुवन् परार्थं परवान् न दूतो वधमर्हति॥
en: Whether honest or otherwise, this one has been commissioned by others. Advocating interest not his own and identifying himself with another, an envoy dose not merit the being put to death.

sa: हंसो यथा राजतपञ्जरस्थः सिंहो यथा मन्दरकन्दरस्थः। वीरो यथा गर्वितकुञ्जरशथश्चेन्द्रोपि बभ्राज तथाम्बरस्थः॥
en: Like a swan in a silver cage, like a lion in a cave in Mandara, like a hero on a haughty elephant, appeared the Moon in the middle of the sky.

sa: सा त्वं गुनिवरं श्रेष्ठं प्रजापतिकुलोद्भवम्। भज विश्रवसं पुत्रि पौलस्त्यं वरय स्वयम्॥
en: Do you, my daughter, seek for your husband that best and foremost of ascetics sprung in the line of Prajăpati Pulastya's son, Viśravā, and of yourself accept him (for your lord).

sa: दुर्योधनो भयाद् विद्वन् न दद्यात् पादमन्ततः। धर्मतस्तु महीं कृत्स्नां प्रदद्याच्छत्रवेऽपि च॥
en: O learned one, Duryodhana will not yield even one foot of ground through fear, but responding to the call of virtue he will yield even the entire world to his enemy.

sa: सुधन्वोवाच गां प्रदद्यास्त्वौरसाय यद्वान्यत् स्यात् प्रियं धनम्। द्वयोर्विवदतोस्तथ्यं वाच्यं च मतिमंस्वया॥
en: Sudhanvan said Keep your cow and whatever wealth you hold dear for yourself; but, O wise man, you should speak the truth in a matter, on which we two are disputing.

sa: तथा पापस्तु तत् सर्वं न करिष्यति कौरवः। तस्मिश्चाक्रियमाणेऽसौ लोके वध्यो भविष्यति॥
en: The one who is such vicious inclinations will not do even that in its entirety, O son of Kuru; and he, refusing compliance with that will deserve death in this world.

sa: दिवि देवर्षयश्चापि देवराजविनाकृताः। न स्म कश्चन देवानां राज्ये वै कुरुते मतिम्॥
en: And the divine saints in heaven also being deprived of the protection of the king of the gods became fearful. No body was inclined to be the king of the gods.

sa: ततः शङ्ख प्रदध्मौ स द्विषतां लोमहर्षणम्। विस्फार्य च धनुःश्रेष्ठं ध्वजे भूतान्यचोदयत्॥
en: He then blew the conch which made the hairs of the enemies stand erect; then twanging his most excellent bow he made the creatures on his flag staff (to cry aloud).

sa: अदासाः पाण्डवाः सन्तु सरथाः सायुधा इति। पयोक्ते यत्र निर्मुक्ता वनवासाय केशव॥
en: "Let the Pandavas be liberated with their chariots and soldiers" was the boon I asked for; and at my solicitation were they liberated and sent to exile in the forest, OKeshava.

sa: अतिक्लेशेन येऽर्थाः स्युर्धर्मस्यातिक्रमेण वा। अरेर्वा प्रणिपातेन मा स्म तेषु मनः कृथाः॥
en: The prosperity which can be attained by excessive toil or by the non-observance of the principles of honesty, or by blowing to an enemy, do not set your heart on these.

sa: सोऽहं पापः कृतघ्नश्च कृपणश्चानृतोऽपि च। गुरोर्यः कृतकार्यः संस्तत् करोमि न भाषितम्॥
en: I am such a wretch, an ungrateful man, without wealth and addicted to false-hood, who, having my wishes gratified by my spiritual guide, am unable to act up to his orders.

sa: त्वं प्रभुः सर्वदेवानां त्वया सर्वमिदं ततम्। त्वं हि देवो महादेव सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः॥
en: You are the Supreme Lord of all the gods and the whole (of this world) is pervaded by you; you, O Lord, are the supreme Lord revered by all the worlds.

sa: मयात्र शक्यं किं कर्तुं विराटे धर्मदूषके। यः पश्यन् मां मर्षयति वध्यमानामनागसम्॥
en: What can I do in the city of Virata, the defiler of virtue, who coolly allows my innocent self thus to be insulted although he sees it (with his own eyes).

sa: भृकुटिं च पुनः कुर्वन्नोष्ठौ च विदशनिवा अभीक्ष्णं दृश्यसे भीम सर्वं तन्मन्युकारितम्॥
en: Other times with your eye-brows contracted and your lips firmly pressed against each other, you gaze at objects before you for a long time. All this is the work of wrath.

sa: यदस्य धर्म्यं मरणं शाश्वतं लोकवर्त्म तत्। समन्तात् सर्वभूतानां न तदत्येति कश्चनः॥
en: The natural death of a man is like the ever recurring point of the wheel of this world. It is the unavoidable path of all creatures and none can avoid it.

sa: धत्ते धारयते चेदमेतस्मात् कारणाद् धनम्। तदेतत् त्रिषु लोकेषु धनं तिष्ठति शाश्वतम्॥
en: Since it supports and maintains the (creatures of the earth Therefore is it called wealth (Dhana); and the wealth is in the three worlds from time immemorial for meeting this purpose.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच ब्राह्मणं यन्त्रिता राजन्नुपस्थास्यामि पूजया। यथाप्रतिज्ञं राजेन्द्र न च मिथ्या ब्रवीम्यहम्॥
en: Kunti said: "O king of kings, agreeably to your promise, I will, by restraining my senses, wait upon and minister to that Brahmana. I am speaking no falsehood (in this respect).

sa: एष शेषः स्थितो नागो येनेयं धार्यते सदा। तपसा लोकमुख्येन प्रभावसहिता मही॥
en: This one staying here is Shesha the Naga, by whom is ever upheld the earth with all her greatness by force of his austerities which is the best in this world.

sa: संजय उवाच श्रुतं मे वासुदेवस्य नामनिर्वचनं शुभम्। यावत् तत्राभिजानेऽहमप्रमेयो हि केशवः॥
en: Sanjaya said The blessed list of name of the son of Vasudeva has been heard by me, from which it seems, so far as I can judge, that Keshava is immeasurable.

sa: धृतिः शमो दमः शौचं कारुण्यं वागनिष्ठुरा। मित्राणां चानभिद्रोहः सप्तैताः समिधः श्रियः॥
en: Wisdom, calmness of mind, self-control, holiness, the reverse of harshness in speech and the intention never to injure one's friends, these seven are to prosperity, even as fuel to the fire.

sa: न ते गतिविद्यते याज्ञसेनि प्रपद्य दासी धार्तराष्ट्रस्य वेश्म। पराजितास्ते पतयो न सन्ति पतिं चान्यं भाविनि त्वं वृणीष्व॥
en: O daughter of Yajnasena, no other course is left open to you; be a slave in the house of son of Dhritarashtra. Your husband vanquished (at a game of dice) no longer are husbands for you and you of a romantic soul, choose some other husbands for yourself.

sa: आह त्वां राघवो राजन् कोसलेन्द्रो महायशाः। प्राप्तकालमिदं वाक्यं तदादत्स्व कुरुष्व च॥
en: "O king, the highly-renowned lord of Kosala, the descendant of Raghu says to you (through me) these words appropriate to the occasion. Accept that (message) and act in obedience to it.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तं दृष्ट्वा क्लीबवेषेण रथस्थं नरपुङ्गवम्। शमीमभिमुखं यान्तं रथमारोप्य चोत्तरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Beholding that foremost of men seated on car in the dress of a person of the neuter sex, going towards the Shami tree, having placed Uttara on the chariot.

sa: विदुर उवाच ऊर्ध्वं प्राणा [त्क्रामन्ति यून: स्थविर आयति। प्रत्युत्थानाभिवादाभ्यां पुनस्तान् प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: Vidura said The heart of a young man soars high, when an old man comes (to his house). He gets it back after rising up and according him a suitable welcome.

sa: ग्राहयित्वाहमात्मानं ततो दग्ध्वा च तां पुरीम्। सम्प्राप्त इति तं रामः प्रियवादिनमार्चयत्॥
en: Then suffering myself to be seized (by the guards) and setting fire to that city (Lanka) I have come back" (Hearing these words) Rama adored that being who spoke agreeable words.

sa: नाहं तामभ्यसूयामि नमो धर्माय वेधसे। कृष्णाय महते नित्यं धर्मो धारयति प्रजाः॥
en: I do not doubt the eventual justification of that foreboding. I bow to Dharma and to the creator and to Krishna who is ever great. Creatures are supported by Dharma (Virtue).

sa: कण्व उवाच मातलिर्नारदेनैव सम्पृष्टः पथि गच्छता। यथावत् सर्वमाचष्ट स्वकार्यं नारदं प्रति॥
en: Kanva said Matali, being thus asked by Narada, who was going on the same road, told Narada all about his business and how it had happened (that he was going there).

sa: इतश्चतुर्दशं वर्ष यन्नापश्यं युधिष्ठिरम्। धनंजयं च गोविन्द यमौ तं च वृकोदरम्॥
en: Nor have I seen Dhananjaya, O Govinda, the twins, Nakula and Sahadeva and also that Vrikodara; people perform the Shradha (obsequies) of absent people under the impression that they are dead.

sa: आत्मजेषु पुरं स्नेहं सर्वभूतानि कुर्वते। प्रियाणि चैषां कुर्वन्ति यथाशक्ति हितानि च॥
en: All creatures have excessive affection for their offsprings; and they also do what is agreeable to the latter to the best of their power and also what leads to their good.

sa: हर्यश्वः सत्यवचने स्थितः स्थित्वा च पौरुषे। दुर्लभत्वाद्धयानां च प्रददौ माधवीं पुनः॥
en: Haryashva, who was ever ready to abide by his words and who made manliness the basis of his action, gave back Madhvi as he could not procure all the horses himself.

sa: तं सदारो विनीतात्मा सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः। पूजया प्रतिजग्राह प्रीयमाणस्तदर्हया॥ तमब्रवीद् रामवचः सौमित्रिरकुतोभयः।
en: And with a humble mind, the monkey-king accompanied by his consort, welcomed him joyously and respectfully. (Then) the dauntless son of Sumitra made him acquainted with the words told by Rama.

sa: मातुः कुलं पितृकुलं यत्र चैव प्रदीयते। कुलत्रयं संशयितं कुरुते कन्यका सताम्॥
en: The family of the mother, the family of the father and the family to which she is given away in marriage-these three families among good people are affected by a daughter.

sa: अकस्माद् द्वेष्टि वै राजन् जन्मप्रभृति पाण्डवान्। प्रियानुवर्तिनो भ्रातॄन् सर्वैः समुदितान् गुणैः।२६।।
en: For no reason do you, Oking, bear malice, even since their birth, to the Pandavas who are your loving followers and brothers and in whom there are developed all the virtues.

sa: परदारासयलभ्या च सततं च पतिव्रता। न चैवोपयिकी भार्या मानुषी कृपणा तव॥
en: Being the wife of another and always attached to my husband I am not to be won over (by you). And this helpless woman cannot be a suitable wife to you.

sa: तैलाभिषिक्तो विकचो मज्जन् पङ्के दशाननः। असकृत् खरयुक्ते तु रथे नृत्यन्निव स्थितः॥
en: (I have in my dream seen) the ten-headed monster dancing repeatedly in a car drawn by assess with his head shaven and his body saturated with oil and besmeared with mud.

sa: शरसंघमहावर्ती नागनक्रां दुरत्ययाम्। महारथमहाद्वीपां शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिस्वनाम्। चकार च तदा पार्थो नदी दुस्तरशोणिताम्॥
en: The mighty car-warriors were the islands and it was filled with the sound of bugles and conchs. Thus Partha made a river of blood which it was so hard to cross.

sa: उच्चावचं बलं ज्ञात्वा मध्यस्थं चापि भारत। प्रहृष्टमप्रहृष्टं च संदधाम तथा परैः॥
en: Determining the efficiency, weakness or indifference of your forces, as well as who amongst them are satisfied and dissatisfied we should enter into fight with our enemies or form a treaty.

sa: कर्ण उवाच न चैतच्छ्रद्दधे वाक्यं क्षत्रिये त्वया। धर्मद्वारं ममैतत् स्यान्नियोगकरणं तव॥
en: Karna said O Kshatriya, lady, I do not respect the words spoken by you, namely the way to virtue lies in my case to do what you urge me to do.

sa: गर्हयित्वा स काकुत्स्थं पपात भुवि मुर्छितः। तारा ददर्श तं भूमौ तारापतिसमौजसम्॥
en: Rebuking the descendant of Kakustha, (for taking his life without cause) he fell down senseless on the ground. Tara then beheld him (Bali) of moon-like splendour, lying (slain) on the earth.

sa: मनसा चिन्तयन् पापं कर्मणा नातिरोचयन्। न प्राप्नोति फलं तस्येत्येवं धर्मविदो विदुः॥
en: Thinking of a sinful act in his mind, if a man does not accomplish it, he does not get the consequences of that act. Utter those that are conversant with religion.

sa: एवं निहत्य भगवान् दैत्येन्द्रं रिपुघातिनम्। भूयोऽन्यः पुण्डरीकाक्षः प्रभुलॊकहिताय च॥ कश्यपस्यात्मजः श्रीमानदित्या गर्भधारितः। पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु प्रसूता गर्भमुत्तमम्॥
en: Having thus slain the king of Daityas, the killer of his enemies, for the behalf of creatures, the lotus-eyed, effulgent lord, again took his birth as Kashyapa's son in the womb of Aditi. At the expiration of full one thousand years she was delivered of that excellent conception.

sa: सपुत्रे त्वयि वृत्तिं च वर्तते यां नराधिप। दाहितश्च निरस्तश्च त्वामेवोपाश्रितः पुनः॥
en: As aiso (you know) his treatment towards yourself and your sons, O ruler of men. He was brunt and he was exiled but again he has come back to your protection.

sa: व्यसने क्लिश्यमानं हि यो मित्रं नाभिपद्यते। अनुनीय यथाशक्ति तं नृशंसं विदुर्बुधाः॥
en: He, who does not seek to serve a friend suffering from a calamity by trying to the best of his abilities, is said to be a cruel man by the wise.

sa: ज्ञातीनां हि मिथो भेदे यन्मित्रं नाभिपद्यते। सर्वयत्नेन माध्यस्थ्यं न तन्मित्रं विदुर्बुधाः॥
en: In a dispute between cousins, the friend who does not serve them as a mediator with all his might, is not said to be a friend at all by wise men.

sa: कर्ण उवाच असंशयं सौहृदान्मे प्रणयाच्चात्थ केशव। सख्येन चैव वार्ष्णेय श्रेयस्कामतयैव च।॥
en: Karna said Undoubtedly, 0 Keshava, you have spoken those words out of good will, love and friendship, O best of the Vrishni race as also from the desire of my benefit.

sa: सोऽसि कर्ण तथा जातः पाण्डोः पुत्रोऽसि धर्मतः। निग्रहाद् धर्मशास्त्राणामेहि राजा भविष्यसि॥
en: You, O Karna, are born in that way and you are therefore morally the son of Pandu; and according to the rulings of the holy books, come and be a king.

sa: त्वमुक्तः कुरुवृद्धेन मया च विदुरेण च। वासुदेवेन च तथा श्रेयो नैवाभिमन्यसे॥
en: You have been spoken to by the oldest among the Kurus, and by myself and by Vidura as also by Vasudeva but you do not accept what is beneficial to you.

sa: यथा मया विनिर्जित्य राजानो वशगाः कृताः। अथ चेन्मा न जानासि सूर्यस्येवोद्यतः प्रभाम्॥ विगाढे युधि सम्बाधे वेत्स्यसे मां जनार्दन। परुपैराक्षिपसि किं व्रणं पूतिमिवोन्नयन्॥
en: And the manner in which after conquering the kings, brought them under subjection. If it is a fact that you do not know my strength, which is like the resplendent sun, you will know then me in the fierce turmoil of battle, O Janardana. You cause me pain by your harsh words like the pain felt in opening a long standing boil.

sa: कृतमेव च तत् सर्वं यथा तस्मै न्यवेदयत्। शिष्यवत् पुत्रवच्चैव स्वसृवच्च सुसंयता॥
en: (But at all these times) Pritha said "everything is ready," and placed the meal before him. And like a disciple, like a daughter or like a sister, with a pure heart.

sa: ततो नादः समभवद् वादित्राणां च निःस्वनः। देवासुराणां सर्वेषां तस्मिन् युद्धे ह्युपस्थिते॥
en: Then, on the eve of that great battle between the gods and the demons, there arose loud peals from both sides, and drums and other musical instruments were beaten and blown.

sa: ततो द्रोणोऽब्रवीद् भीष्मः कृपो द्रौणिश्च भारत। मत्वा मां महतीं चिन्तामास्थितं व्यथितेन्द्रियम्॥
en: Then did Drona and Bhima and Kripa and the son of Drona thus speak, O Bharata, thinking me to be in the midst of great anxiety and with the senses tortured.

sa: रूपमङ्गयं तथा कान्तिः सौकुमार्यमनुत्तमम्। कान्त्या विभाति वक्त्रं ते शशाङ्क इव निर्मलम्।।१३।
en: Your beauty is rankled as the foremost of its order, so also is your gracefulness. Excellent is your tenderness; in respect of loveliness your countenance shines as clearly as the moon.

sa: बालखिल्या ऊचुः एकपादेन वृत्त्यर्थं ग्रामद्वारे स तिष्ठतु। धर्मज्ञस्त्यक्तधर्मास्तु यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: The Balakhilyas said Let him who has stolen your stalks stand on one foot at the entrance of a village. Let him, while knowing all duties, be guilty of every transgression.

sa: अनेन वाससाच्छन्नः स्वं रूपं प्रतिपत्स्यसे। इत्युक्त्वा प्रददौ तस्मै दिव्यं वासोयुगं तदा॥
en: Wearing these pieces of cloth, you shall recover your proper form. Having said this, the king of the snakes then gave to him (Nala) two pieces of cloth of superior worth."

sa: वायव्यमादाय ततोऽपरास्त्रं रामः प्रचिक्षेप निशाचराय। समुद्गरं तेन जहार बाहुं •सकृत्तबाहुस्तुमुलं ननाद॥
en: Then Rāma, taking a trighty Vāyavya weapon, used the same against the night-ranger; and cut off his arm with the mace. And having his arm cut off, he set up tremendousrears.

sa: तमसा संवृते लोके न प्राज्ञायत किंचन। कौरवाणां प्रकाशेन दृश्यन्ते विद्रुताः परे॥
en: Then the troops were shrouded in darkness and nothing could be discerned. Only the flight of the foe could be determined through the light that the torches of the Kauravas shed.

sa: किं नु कर्माशुभं पूर्वं कृतवत्यन्यजन्मनि। यदहं बान्धवैस्त्यक्ता बाल्ये सम्प्रति च त्वया।॥
en: What great sin did I commit of old in some other life that I was cast away by my parents in my infancy and now I am cast away by you?

sa: गच्छ तातानुजाने त्वां कैकेयी सुप्रजास्त्वया। मातरं कुशलं ब्रूयाः पितरं च परंतप॥
en: Go, my child; I permit you. Kaikeyi is mother of a worthy son through you. Do you O subduer of foes, communicate our welfare to both your father and your mother.

sa: कृतोदका नरव्याघ्र आदित्यं पर्युपासते। स तैाह्मणमभ्यस्तं सहितैर्ब्रह्मवित्तमैः। रविरस्तंगतो राम गच्छोदकमुपस्पृश ॥
en: Having accepted adoration in the shape of Vedic hymns chanted by Brāhmaṇas, wellversed in Vedas, the illustrious Aditya is about to be set. Therefore, O Rāma, do you perform the ceremony.

sa: विद्योपजीविनोऽन्नं च यो भुङ्क्ते साधुसम्मतः। तदप्यन्नं यथा शौद्रं तत् साधुः परिवर्जयेत्॥
en: If a good Brahmana takes the food of one who lives by his learning. he is considered as taking the food of a Shudra. All good men should avoid such food.

sa: नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः। ऊचुर्ज्ञानविदो वृद्धाः प्रत्ययो मोक्षलक्षणम्॥
en: The learned old men have said that neither this world, nor that hereafter, nor bliss can come to one who is full of doubts. Faith is the certain sign of salvation.

sa: तथा गा: कपिला दोन्ध्री: सवत्साः पाण्डुनन्दनः। हेमशृङ्गा रौप्यखुरा दत्त्वा चक्रे प्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: Then the son of Pandu, giving unto them milch cow, that yielded milk whenever touched, with calves and with their horns and hoofs decked with gold and silver respectively, circumambulated them.

sa: स वैधर्मो विप्रलब्धः सभायां पापात्मभिः सौबलेयप्रधानैः। आहूय कुन्तीसुतमक्षवत्यां पराजैषीत् सत्यसंधं सुतस्ते॥
en: Virtue was destroyed by the wicked souls (the Kuru princes) with Subala's son (Shakuni) at their head when your sons invited the virtuous Yudhishthira to play and defeated him at dice.

sa: ततो राजञ्जामदग्न्यो महात्मा शक्ती?रा व्याक्षिपद्धेमदण्डाः। विचित्रिताः काञ्चनपट्टनद्धा यथा महोल्का ज्वलितास्तथा ताः॥
en: Then did the great souled of Jamadagni, O king, hurl at me fierce arrows having golden handles which were variegated and furnished with golden wings. They were blazing like great meteors.

sa: अथ तान् व्यथितान् दृष्ट्वा सह मात्रा नरोत्तमान्। नावमारोष्य गङ्गायां प्रस्थितानब्रवीत् पुनः॥
en: Seeing those best of men with their mother pensive and sad, he made them get on the boat that was on the Ganges. Going with them hiniself, he again said ..

sa: ऋष्यशृङ्गपुरोगाश्च प्रत्यूचुर्नृपतिं तदा॥ सम्भाराः सम्भ्रियन्तां ते तुरगश्च विमुच्यताम्। सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम्॥
en: The Brāhmaṇas headed by Rsyaśộnga addressed the king, saying, Do you arrange for the provisions, loose the horse, and prepare the sacrificial ground on the north bank of the Sarayū river!

sa: वधमेव प्रशंसन्ति शत्रूणामपकारिणाम्। सुविदीर्णं सुविक्रान्तं सुयुद्धं सुपलायितम्॥ आपद्यापदि काले च कुर्वीत न विचारयेत्। नावज्ञेयो रिपुस्तात दुर्बलौऽपि कथंचन।॥
en: The killing of a harmful foe is always praiseworthy. If he be powerful, if he be a great warrior, one should watch for the hour of his disaster and then kill him without any scruple. O son, if the enemy be weak, still he should not be scorned.

sa: स भवान् क्षत्रियगुणैर्युक्तः सर्वैः कुलोद्वहः। अविपश्चिद् यथा वाचं व्याहरन् नाद्य शोभसे॥
en: Yourself endowed with all the desirable qualifications of a Kshatriya, O perpetuator of your race, it looks odd that you should speak like one ignorant of the duties of your order.

sa: यत् पुरा न निगृह्णासि वार्यमाणो महात्मभिः। वैचित्रवीर्य तस्येदं फलं पश्य सुदारुणम्॥
en: Now do you see, O son of Vichitravirya, the dreadful fruit of your refusal to accept the salutary advice (of your friends), though warned against it by many high souled heroes.

sa: तस्य विक्षिपतश्चापं श्रुतकीर्तेर्महास्वनम्। चिच्छेद समरे तूर्णं जयत्सेनः सुतस्तव॥ क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन प्रहसन्निव भारत। तं दृष्ट्वा छिन्नधन्वानं शतानीकः सहोदरम्॥
en: Then in that conflict ( monarch your son Jayatsena with a sharp edged Kshurapra (horse-shoe-headed shaft), as if smiling, cut off the bow of that high-souled warrior, namely Shrutakirti, 0 Bharata, as the latter came repeatedly stretching it. Thereupon Shatanika seeing his uterine brother deprived of his bow.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अथाब्रवीन्मयः पार्थमर्जुनं जयतां वरम्। आपृच्छे त्वां गमिष्यामि पुनरेष्यामि चाप्यहम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then Maya spoke thus to the son of Pritha, Arjuna, the foremost of all victorious warriors, "I shall now go away with your permission, but shall soon come back.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच भृगोः शापाद् भृशं भीतो जातवेदाः प्रतापवान्॥ शमीगर्भमथासाद्य ननाश भगवांस्ततः।
en: Vaishampayana said The highly powerful Agni became very much frightened at the curse of Bhrigu, Concealing himself within the entrails of the Shami wood, that worshipful god disappeared from the view.

sa: प्रेष्य चाग्निरथर्वाणमन्यं देशं ततोऽगमत्। मत्स्यास्तस्य समाचख्युः क्रुद्धस्तानग्निरब्रवीत्। भक्ष्या वै विविधैर्भावैर्भविष्यथ शरीरिणाम्॥
en: Having thus spoken to Atharvan, the fire went away to some other place. But his place of concealment was divulged by the fish, Upon them he passed this course in anger.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच महानपनयः सूत ममैवात्र विशेषतः। स इदानीमनुप्राप्तो मन्ये संजय शोचतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said I see, O son of a charioteer, that mine has been the greatest fault in this matter; O Sanjaya, the consequences have now overtaken me, grieve though I may!

sa: ताविमौ चन्दनेनाक्तौ चन्दना) च मे भुजौ॥ याभ्यां दुर्योधनो नीतः क्षयं ससुतबान्धवः।
en: Smeared with sandal-paste and deserving of that adornment are those two arms of mine by which Duryodhana has been sent to the other world along with all his sons and kinsmen.'

sa: नृपेणाहूयमानस्य यत् तिष्ठति भयं हृदि। न तत् तिष्ठति तुष्टानां वने मूलफलाशिनाम्॥
en: The fear, which possesses the heart of a person, who is summoned by the king is unknown to persons passing their days happily in the forest, living upon fruits and roots.

sa: सर्वमप्येतदेकस्य नालं संजय कस्यचित्। तात संहत्य जीवामो द्विषतां मा वशं गमः॥
en: All this kingdom is too much, O Sanjaya, for any body. You should say this speaking on our behalf-Sire, we shall live united; do not go into the clutches of despisers.

sa: सशरीरो दिवं यायामिति मे सौम्यदर्शन॥ मया चेष्टं क्रतुशतं तच्च नावाप्यते फलम्।
en: O you of placid presence, I had desired to repair to heaven in body. By me have an hundred sacrifices been performed, but yet do I not obtain the fruit thereof.

sa: रुक्माङ्गदी रुक्मवर्मा रुक्मपुङ्खरवारयत्। ततोऽशीतिं शिनेः पौत्रः सायकान् कृतवर्मणे॥ प्राहिणोत् त्वरया युक्तो द्रष्टकामो धनंजयम्। सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुतापनः॥
en: Decked with golden Angadas and clad in a golden mail, covered Satyaki with arrow of golden wings. Thereafter the grandson of Sini quickly sped numerous shafts at Kritavarman, as he was longing to have a sight of Dhananjaya. Pierced deeply by his powerful adversary, that scorcher of foes.

sa: स तस्य सशरं चापं छित्त्वा राजन् महानसिः। अभ्यगाद् धरणी राजंश्च्युतं ज्योतिरिवाम्बरात्॥
en: O king, then that mighty sword, cutting off his bow with arrows placed on its string, dropped, O king, on the ground like a luminous body falling down from the skies.

sa: द्रोणो हि बलवाञ्छूरः कृतास्त्रश्च जितश्रमः। प्रतिज्ञातं च तेनैतद् ग्रहणं मे महारथ॥
en: Drona is endued with prowess and he is heroic, accomplished in the use of weapons, and indifatigable (in battle). O mighty carwarrior, even he has resolved to bring about my capture.

sa: हते तु पुरुषव्याघ्ने रणे सत्यजिति प्रभो। सर्वैरपि समेतैर्वा न स्थातव्यं कथंचन॥
en: If, on the other hand, O master, this foremost of men, Satyajit, be slain in battle, then you shall not stay in the field even if surrounded by all (our warriors).

sa: अयं स कालः सम्प्राप्तो वर्षपूगाभिवाञ्छितः। अद्य त्वां निहनिष्यामि यदि नोत्सृजसे रणम्॥
en: The hour has come that I have been loO king forward to so anxiously for all these years. Today I will slay you, if indeed you, you do not abandon fighting.

sa: विसर्जयामास ततः म मन्त्रिणो विधानमाज्ञाप्य पुष्कलम्। जयाशिषा मन्त्रिगणेन पूजितो विवेश सोऽन्तःपुरमृद्धिमन्महत्॥
en: Having thus completely provided for the defence of the city, he dismissed the ministers; and, honoured by the counsellors with blessings of victory, (then) entered his magnificent and splendid inner apartment.

sa: स वृत्र इव वज्रेण फेनेन नमुचिर्यथा। बलो वेन्द्राशनिहतो निपपात हतः खरः॥
en: And threat Khara slain fell down like Vritra slain by the thunder-bolt, or Namuci by foam, or Bala by Indra's Ašani. Namuci was slain by a thunder-bolt laid over with foam.

sa: खं च भूमिं च संरुद्धां मेनिरे क्षत्रियर्षभाः। पुनरिण नादेन पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: The foremost of the Kshatriyas regarded the welkin and the earth to be filled completely by its echo. Then again at the dreadful cries uttered by the illustrious son of Pandu.

sa: तयोराह्निकवेलायां तस्य कौतूहलं त्वभूत्। इदं तदास्पदं कृत्स्नं यस्मिल्लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥ सदेवासुरगन्धर्वाः सकिन्नरमहोरगाः।
en: He said to himself,-This is truly the retreat of that Being in whom are placed all the worlds including the gods, the Asuras, the Gandharvas, the Kinnaras, and the great snakes.

sa: ते वयं कौरवेयाणामेतेषां च महात्मनाम्। कथं न बध्यतां तात गच्छाम जगतस्तथा॥
en: O son, (if we do this), why should we not deserve death at the hands of the Kurus and of those illustrious men (Bhishma and others), nay of the whole world?

sa: सौतिरुवाच बहुत्वान्नामधेयानि पन्नगानां तपोधन। न कीर्तयिष्ये सर्वेषां प्राधान्येन तु मे शृणु॥
en: Sauti said: O Rishi, for fear of being lengthy, I shall not mention the names of all the snakes. But hear, I shall only mention the names of the chief ones.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच ज्ञायतामस्य यद् यतश्चैव समुत्थितम्। विदित्वा व्यवसिष्यामि यद्यपि स्यात् सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Bhima said: Learn what distress and from what cause that distress has befallen him. Having learnt it, I shall try to remove it (his distress), however difficult its achievement may be.

sa: यथा नष्टं पुरा देवा गूढमग्निं गुहागतम्। यथा स यज्ञो न भवेद्यथा वापि पराभवः। जनमेजयस्य सर्पाणां विनाशकरणाय वै॥
en: As did the celestials, in the days of yore, to regain the lost Agni who had concealed himself within a cave, cave, so that the sacrifice of Janamejaya for the destruction of the snakes may not take place and so that we may not meet with our destruction.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच ममैव वचनादेष करिष्यति परंतपः। ब्राह्मणार्थे महत् कृत्यं मोक्षाय नगरस्य च॥
en: Kunti said: By my request the chastiser of foes (Bhima) will do this great deed for the sake of the Brahmana and in order to save the town (from the Rakshasa).

sa: समृद्धमायुधागारमिदं तस्य दुरात्मनः। वप्रान्तं निष्पतीकारमाश्रित्येदं कृतं महत्॥ इदं तदशुभं नूनं तस्य कर्म चिकीर्षितम्। प्रागेव विदुरो वेद तेनास्मानन्वबोधयत्॥
en: Here is that wicked man's well stocked arsenal. This large house has been built abutting the high walls of the arsenal, without having any out let. This most curse device which was made (for our destruction) was known to Vidura and I was told of it by him.

sa: मेघस्तनितनिर्घोषैर्विद्युत्पवनकम्पितैः। तैर्मेधैः सततासारं वर्षद्भिरनिशं तदा॥ नष्टचन्द्रार्ककिरणमम्बरं समपद्यत। नागानामुत्तमो हर्षस्तथा वर्षति वासवे॥
en: The sky thus became dark, the rays of the sun and the moon disappeared on account of the incessant downpour. And upon Indra's causing this downpour, the Nagas became exceedingly delighted.

sa: कक्षघ्नः शिशिरघ्नश्च महाकक्षे बिलौकसः। न देहदिति चात्मानं यो रक्षति स जीवति॥
en: He lives who protects himself by the knowledge that neither the consumer of straw and wood not the drier of dews burns the inmates of a hole in the deep forest.

sa: अस्त्राग्निना विचित्रोऽयं दग्धो मे रथ उत्तमः। सोऽहं चित्ररथो भूत्वा नाम्ना दग्धरथोऽभवम्॥
en: My excellent and beautiful chariot has been brunt by your fire weapon. I was (formerly) called Chitraratha having a beautiful chariot, I shall now be called Dagdharatha (having the chariot) burnt..

sa: ततो भागीकृतो देवैर्वज्रभाग उपास्यते। लोके यशो धनं किंचित् सैव वज्रतनुः स्मृता॥
en: Thereupon the celestials worshipped those fragments of the thunder thus broken into pieces. That which is known in the world as the wealth of fame is a portion of the thunder.

sa: के भवन्तोऽवलम्बन्ते गर्ने ह्यस्मिन्नधोमुखाः। वीरणस्तम्बके लग्नाः सर्वतः परिभक्षिते॥ मूषकेन निगूढेन गर्तेऽस्मिन्नित्यवासिना।
en: “Who are you thus hanging in the hole, your heads downward, by a rope of the Virana fibre which has been eaten by the rats that live secretly near this hole?"

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच एवमुक्तस्तत: सूदः सोऽनासाद्यामिषं क्वचित्। निवेदयामास तदा तस्मै राज्ञे व्यथान्वितः॥
en: The Gandharva said : Having been thus addressed, the cook (went away in search of meat), but having failed to procure any meat, he sorrowfully informed the king (of his failure).

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच एवमुक्तस्तया हृष्टो वसिष्ठः श्रेष्ठभागृषिः। अस्ति संतानमित्युक्त्वा मृत्योः पार्थ न्यवर्तत॥
en: The Gandharva said: Having been thus addressed by her, that best of Rishis, Vasishtha, became exceedingly glad. O Partha, saying, "There is a child (of my race)”, he refrained from self-destruction.

sa: ददृशुर्ब्राह्मणी तेऽथ दीप्यमानां स्वतेजसा। अथ गर्भः स भित्त्वोर्स ब्राह्मण्या निर्जगाम ह॥
en: On this the child in her thing came out tearing open the thigh came out tearing open the thigh and dazzling the eyes of the Kshatriyas like a mid day sun.

sa: तमेव यूयं याचध्वमौर्वं मम सुत्तोत्तमम्। अयं वः प्रणिपातेन तुष्टो दृष्टी: प्रमोक्ष्यति॥
en: O children, therefore, pray to my this excellent son, born of my thigh. Propitiated by your homage and by your bowing down your head to him, he may restore your eye-sight.

sa: आस्तीकः किल यज्ञं तं वर्तन्तं भुजगोत्तमे। प्रतिषेत्स्यति मां पूर्वं स्वयमाह पितामहः॥
en: O best of the women of the snake race,। Astika will put an end to this sacrifice which is being performed. The Grandsire himself told me this in time gone by.

sa: हूयमाने भृशं दीप्तं विधिवद्वसुरेतसि। न स्म स प्राप तद्वन्हौ तक्षको भयपीडितः॥
en: For Takshaka, though benumbed with fear, did not at once fall into the fire, although libations were poured into the blazing sacrificial fire in his name and in the proper form.

sa: ते तत्र वीराः परमासनेषु सपादपीद्देप्वविशरूमानाः। यथानुपूर्वं विविशुनराग्र्या: तथा महार्हेषु न विस्मयन्तः॥
en: Those heroes without any hesitation and awkwardness sat with perfect fearlessness on costly seats furnished with footstools; and they sat one after the other according to the order of their age.

sa: एष धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो भविष्यति नरोत्तमः। विक्रान्तः सत्यवाक् त्वेव राजा पृथ्व्यां भविष्यति॥
en: “This (child) will be the west of men and the foremost of all the virtuous. He will be truthful and (also) greatly powerful; he will be the ruler of the earth.

sa: यदाश्रौषं द्रोणमाचार्यमेकं धृष्टद्युम्नेनाभ्यतिक्रम्य धर्मम्। रथोपस्थे प्रायगतं विशस्तं तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Dhrishtadyumna, violating all the rules of war, had killed Drona while insensible on his chariot and bent on death.

sa: ममवाये ततो राज्ञां कन्यां भर्तु स्वयंवराम्। प्राप्तवानर्जुनः कृष्णां कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्॥१२५।
en: A few years after, Arjuna, after performing a difficult feat of archery, obtained the hands of Draupadi at the Svayamvara in the midst of a great assemblage of kings and princes.

sa: गतवानस्मि तं देशं युद्धं यत्राभवत् पुरा! कुरूणां-पाण्डवानां च सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम्॥
en: And where in the days of yore the sons of Kuru and Pandu had fought a deadly battle, in which all the Chiefs of India joined one side or the other.

sa: प्रत्युद्ययुश्च तं प्राप्तं सर्वे भीष्मपुरोगमाः। ते नदूरमिवाध्वानं गत्वा नागपुरालयात्॥ आवृतं ददृशशुहष्टा लोकं बहुविधैर्धनैः। नानायानसमानीतै रत्नैरुच्चावचैस्तदा॥ हस्त्यश्वरथरत्नैश्च गोभिरुष्ट्रैस्तथादिभिः। नान्तं ददृशुरासाद्य भीष्मेण सह कौरवाः॥
en: All the Kurus with Bhishma at their head went out to receive him when he was near Hastinapur. They saw in delight the attendants of the king (Pandu), laden with much wealth; the train of various conveyances, of elephants, horses, cars, kine, camels and other animals laden with all kinds of wealth was so long that they could not find its end.

sa: दत्त्वा स भगिनीं वीरो यथार्ह च परिच्छदम्। पुनरायात् स्वनगरं भीष्मेण प्रतिपूजितः॥
en: The nuptials were solemnised with the permission of Bhishma. The hero (Shakuni), giving away his sister with (many valuable) robes, returned to his own capital, after being duly worshipped by Bhishma.

sa: तां स सुश्राव काकुत्स्थः पूर्वाचार्यविनिर्मिताम्। अपूर्वां पाठ्यजातिं च गेयेन समलंकृताम्॥ प्रमाणैर्बहुभिर्बद्धां तन्त्रीलयसमन्विताम् । बालाभ्यां राघवः श्रुत्वा कौतूहलपरोऽभवत्॥
en: That song was composed by the first preceptor (Vālmīki) never heard of before, consisting of sounds originating from six places, containing all metres, many proofs and set in accompaniment with the music of a stringed instrument. Hearing such a song from the boys Rāma was stricken with curiosity.

sa: अहं कामचरी सौम्य तवास्मि वशवर्तिनी। प्रशाधि मां सोमसुत यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु॥
en: O gentle one, I am not subject to any body; I surrender myself to you out of my own accord. O son of Soma, you may command me whatever you wish.

sa: गृहाण च वरं सौम्य यं त्वमिच्छस्यारिंदम। स्वर्गभाङ् नहि शूद्रोऽयं त्वत्कृते रघुनन्दन॥
en: O slayer of foes, do you now crave a boon. O descendant of Raghu, being slain by you this Sūdra has been able to attain to the abode of the celestials.

sa: दिष्ट्या ते विजयो वत्स दिष्ट्या लवणराक्षसः। हतः पुरुषशार्दूल वरं वरय सुव्रत।२।।
en: O child, fortunate it is that you have been crowned with success after slaying the Rākṣasa Lavaņa. Do you, therefore, O foremost of men, O you of firm vows, accept boons.

sa: मूर्धाभिषिक्तं नृपतिं प्रधानपुरुषो बलात्। आदत्ते न च नो हृष्टोऽभागः पुरुषतः क्वचित्॥
en: Having become the foremost of all be attacks with force the kings that wear crowns. There is not to be found a single king who does not pay tributes to him.

sa: सर्वैरपि गुणैर्युक्तो निर्वीयः किं करिष्यति। गुणीभूता गुणाः सर्वे तिष्ठन्ति हि पराक्रमे॥
en: One, who is endued with all accomplishments, but who is destitute of velour, can hardly ever accomplish any thing. Every merit exists by the side of velour in an incipient state.

sa: न ह्यस्मिन् शीलहीनो वा निर्वीर्यो वा नराधिपः। प्रजाविरहितो वापि भूतपूर्वः कथंचन॥
en: I have heard that in the dynasty of Puru there was not a single king who was deficient in good behaviour or in prowess. There was none who has no sons.

sa: श्रूयते हि पुरा राजा नृगो नाम महायशाः। बभूव पृथिवीपालो ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यवाक्शुचिः॥
en: I have heard, O foremost of men, that there lived in the days of yore a highly illustrious, truthful and pure-minded king, ever devoted to the Brahmanas, by the name Nrga.

sa: प्रकृतय ऊचुः यः पुत्रो गुमसम्पन्नो मातापित्रोर्हितः सदा। सर्वमर्हति कल्याणं कनीयानपि सत्तमः॥
en: The people said : O king, it is true that, the son who is accomplished and who seeks the good of his parents, deserves all prosperity, though he is the youngest.

sa: धर्मज्ञ इति विख्यात एष राजा भृगूद्वह। अतिक्रान्तश्च मर्यादां काव्यैतत् कथयामि ते॥
en: O son of Bhrigu, this king is renowned for his knowledge in religion and virtue. But, O son of Kavi, I tell you, he has fallen from the path of virtue.

sa: ययातिरुवाच ब्रह्मचर्येण वेदो मे कृत्स्नः श्रुतिपथं गतः। राजाहं राजपुत्रश्च ययातिरिति विश्रुतः॥
en: this your Yayati said : In my Brahmacharya, the whole of the Vedas entered my ears. I am a king and a son of a king; I am known as Yayati.

sa: एवंगते नरश्रेष्ठे पाण्डवे सत्यवादिनी। अस्माकं गमनं व्यक्तं वनं प्रति भवेत् पुनः॥
en: If the truthful son of Pandu, that foremost of the Pandavas (Yudhishthira) be captured by Drona, it is evident that we shall have to go the forest in exile once more.

sa: सुतसोमं तु शकुनिर्विद्ध्वा तु निशितैः शरैः। नाकम्पयत संक्रुद्धो वार्योघ इव पर्वतम्॥
en: Shakuni, who became very angry after having pierced Sutasoma with excellently sharpened arrows, could not cause him to tremble (with fear); even as a torrent of rain cannot shake a mountain.

sa: यथा कर्णश्च कौन्तेयैः सह युद्धमयोजयत्। यथा च द्विषतां हन्ता रणे शान्तस्तदुच्यताम्॥
en: Relate to me also how the sons of Kunti conducted the battle with Karna and do you tell me, again, how that slayer of enemies became quiet (was slain) in battle.

sa: द्रोणेनैव सह क्रुद्धाः सात्यकिं समुपाद्रवन्। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरुणां सात्वतस्य च। द्रोणस्य च रणे राजन् घोरं देवासुरोपमम्॥
en: Rushed at him in rage, accompanied by Drona himself. Then, O king, there ensued a fight between the Kurus headed by Drona on one side and Yuyudhana on the other, that resembled the dreadful battle that was fought in days gone by, between the Gods and the Asuras.

sa: न चैनं संयुगे कश्चित् समर्थः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्। न चैनमर्जुनो जातु प्रतियुध्येत धर्मवित्॥
en: None can now even look at him in battle. Knowing the rules of fair combat even Arjuna will not now fight with him." (Even thus did they talk with each other).

sa: जयद्रथवधान्वेषी प्रतिज्ञां कृतवान् हि यः॥ कचित् स सैन्धवं संख्ये हनिष्यति धनंजयः।
en: And even now endeavouring to compass the death of Jayadratha, he that has made a terrible vow, viz., Dhananjaya, will he succeed in slaying the king of the Sindhus in battle.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच दैवमेव परं मन्ये धिक् पौरुषमनर्थकम्। यत्राधिरथिरायत्तो नातरत् पाण्डवं रणे॥
en: Dhritarastra said I consider Destiny to be supreme. Fie on the useless exertions of man, inasmuch the son of Adhiratha striving vigorously, was not able to conquer Pandus's son in battle.

sa: उलूकस्तं तु विंशत्या विद्ध्वा स्वर्णविभूषितैः। अथास्य समरे क्रुद्धो ध्वजं चिच्छेद काञ्चनम्॥
en: Uluka, too, who became highly wrathful, after having pierced him (Yuyutsu) with twenty arrows, decked with gold, struck down his standards, that was made of gold, in the field of battle.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु कृष्णेन गृह्य भल्लांश्चतुर्दश। त्वरमाणस्तवराकाले द्रौणेर्धनुरथाच्छिनत्॥ ध्वजं छत्रं पताकाश्च खङ्ग शक्तिं गदां तथा। जत्रुदेशे च सुभृशं वत्सदन्तैरताडयत्॥
en: Hearing those words Arjuna just on the nick of time seizing fourteen Bhallas (arrows, with crescent-shaped heads) darted them off, piercing right through his weapons, chariot, standard and umbrella and dismantling Ashvatthama of his equipment's, bows, darts and all. He (Arjuna), then assailing him (Ashvatthama) with calf-toothed arrows.

sa: एवं सिद्धाऽब्रुवन् वाचो भविष्यति च तत् तथा। तस्मात्त्वं पुरुषव्याघ्र पञ्चालाञ्जहि सानुगान्॥
en: It will surely come to pass as the worshipful sages who have attained (ascetic) success have said this. Therefore O most valiant of men, destroy the Panchalas together with their followers.

sa: यं स्म द्रोणः सुतं प्राप्य केशग्रहमवाप्तवान्। स तथाहं करिष्यामि तथा भरतसत्तम।॥
en: Inasmuch as getting me for his son, Drona had to suffer the indignity of being seized by the hair. O foremost of the Bharatas, I shall therefore so exert myself that.

sa: त्वां चाप्यद्य वधिष्यामि सह पुत्रं सबान्धवम्। तिष्ठेदानीं रणे यत्तः कौरवोऽसि महारथः॥
en: I will today destroy you also together with your sons and friends, you are a descendant of the Kuru race and are endued with great prowess. Now remain carefully in battle.

sa: येन दिव्यास्त्रविच्छूरो मायावी स घटोत्कचः। अमोघया रणे शक्त्या निहतो भैरवं नदन्॥
en: It is by him that Ghatotkacha, thai wielder of celestial weapon, that god, that enchanter, that one who made a tremendous roar, was slain in battle through the most indomitable power.

sa: संजय उवाच ध्वजान् बहुविधाकाराशृणु तेषां महात्मनाम्। रूपतो वर्णतश्चैव नामतश्च निबोध मे॥
en: Sanjaya said Hear from me of the diverse kinds of standards belonging to those illustrious warriors. Listen to me, as I go on describing their name, their appearance and their hue.

sa: युगन्धरे पयः पीत्वा प्रोष्य चाप्यच्युतस्थले॥ तद्वद् भूतिलये स्नात्वा कथं स्वर्ग गमिष्यति।
en: How can a man attain to the celestial region having drunk milk in the town called Yugandhara and lived in the place called Achyutastala and bathed in the spot called Bhutilaya.

sa: अद्य तप्स्यति राधेयः पाञ्चालीं यत्तदाब्रवीत्। सभामध्ये वचः क्रूरं कुत्सयन् पाण्डवान् प्रति॥
en: The contumely which the son of Radha gave expression to, in addressing the Princess of Panchala in the open court, vilifying the Pandavas, will today make him repent of his misdemeanour.

sa: यस्य बाहुबलं सर्वे समाश्रित्य महात्मनः। वनवासानिवृत्ताः स्म न च युद्धेषु निर्जिताः॥
en: With the help of the strength of arms of that hero of illustrious soul, we have been able to come back from our exile and have never been defeated in battle.

sa: अर्जुनार्जुन बीभत्सो न न्यस्यं गाण्डिवं त्वया। शशाङ्कस्येव ते पङ्को नैर्मल्यं पातयिष्यति॥
en: O Arjuna, O Arjuna, O Vibhatsu, it befits you not to lay aside your Gandiva-bow; then from yourself the halo of glory will be gone, like that of moon leaving it."

sa: तयोस्तु धनुषी चित्रे भल्लाभ्यां श्वेतवाहनः। चिच्छेद समरे तूर्णं ध्वजौ च कनकोज्ज्वलौ॥
en: Then that hero of white steeds with a pair of broad-headed shafts, quickly cut-off in that battle the two wonderful bows of those princes, as also their standards of golden effulgence.

sa: शल्य उवाच यदि कर्ण रणे हन्यादद्य त्वां श्वेतवाहनः। उभावेकरथेनाहं हन्यां माधवपाण्डवौ॥
en: Shalya said The king of Madras said-"O Karna, if you are today killed by this grey-horsed Arjuna I alone on a single car will put both Madhava and Phalguna to death."

sa: आसन्नमागतं दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नं जिघांसया। शरैर्वैतस्तिकै राजन् विव्याधासन्नवेधिभिः॥ योधयामास समरे धृष्टद्युम्नं महारथम्। ते हि वैतस्तिका नाम शरा आसन्नयोधिनः॥
en: But beholding Dhristadyumna inflamed with a desire for slaughtering him so near, he began to pierce him with arrows measuring a span only and so fit to be used in close quarter. Those arrows known by the name of Vaitastika and fit to be used in close quarters.

sa: तमापतन्तं नकुलं सोऽभिपत्य समन्ततः सायकैः प्रत्यविद्धयत्। विव्याध वीरं स चुकोप विद्धः॥
en: Then Karna's son all of a sudden, rushed against the advancing Nakula and distressed him with hosts of sharp shafts from all sides in order to put an end to him.

sa: रुद्रौ द्वाविव सम्भूतौ यथा द्वाविव भास्करौ। यमौ वा पुरुषव्याघ्रौ घौररूपावुभौ रणे॥
en: As if both of them are born like two Rudras, or like two light-giving suns. 'Both these foremost of persons of dreadful forms are standing in the battle like two Yamas.'
